p.D_eff <= 30 := by simp [p, get_domain_params]; norm_num have h_adj_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + new_perceived_param * log (p.D_eff / 25) := lt_trans (by norm_num) (perceived_adjust_lo p h_D_bounds) have h_base := term1_base_negative_for_high_D_eff p h_D_bounds.1 h_obs cmb_delta_bounds (by simp [p, get_domain_params]) (by simp [p, get_domain_params]) have h_term1 : term1 p = term1_base p * (1 + new_perceived_param * log (p.D_eff / 25))
